title: AntiFakeLag
description: a plugin that aims to be a small anti-cheat but blocks fake lags and distinguishes them from regular ones
body:
# ⚡ AntiFakeLag

Detect lag switching, fakelag, and suspicious network manipulation before it becomes a problem.

**AntiFakeLag** is a lightweight server-side detection plugin that analyzes packet timing patterns and player behavior to identify abnormal network activity that traditional ping-based checks often miss.

Built for competitive servers, PvP communities, and administrators who want better visibility into suspicious connection behavior.

> Requires ProtocolLib

---

## ✨ Features

### 📦 Packet Timing Analysis

Monitors movement and keep-alive packet timing to identify unusual network patterns.

### 🚨 Burst Detection

Detects large bursts of packets and movement after periods of suspicious inactivity.

### 📊 Network Stability Tracking

Uses variance analysis to evaluate connection consistency over time.

### 🎯 Behavioral Lag Scoring

Generates a dynamic suspicion score from **0 to 100** based on observed behavior.

### ⚙️ Fully Configurable

Customize thresholds, alerts, and actions to fit your server.

### 🪶 Lightweight Design

Built to provide detailed analysis without impacting server performance.

### 🚫 Not Ping-Based

Ping is only part of the picture.

AntiFakeLag focuses on packet flow and player behavior instead of relying solely on latency values.

---

## 🔍 How It Works

Traditional systems often assume that high ping automatically explains unusual movement.

AntiFakeLag takes a different approach.

The plugin continuously monitors packet consistency, timing intervals, and movement patterns. When packet flow suddenly stops and later resumes in large bursts, the behavior is analyzed and contributes to a dynamic suspicion score.

This allows the plugin to identify patterns commonly associated with:

* ⚡ Lag switching
* 📡 Artificial packet delay
* 🕒 Fakelag tools
* 🎮 Network manipulation exploits

---

## 🚦 Detection Responses

When configured thresholds are exceeded, AntiFakeLag can:

* 📝 Log suspicious activity
* 🔔 Notify online staff members
* ⚙️ Execute configurable server commands

By default, the plugin focuses on detection and visibility rather than automatic punishment.

---

## 🎯 Why AntiFakeLag?

Because a player can have perfectly normal ping and still manipulate network behavior.

Traditional checks see latency.

AntiFakeLag analyzes the packets themselves.

---

## 🧩 Requirements

* ProtocolLib
* Paper / Spigot
* Java 17+

---

## 📈 Performance

AntiFakeLag was designed to operate continuously with minimal overhead.

Packet analysis is optimized to provide useful detection data without becoming another source of server lag.

The irony of a lag detection plugin causing lag was considered unacceptable.
